name: Ultrasonic NDE benchmark problems (full-wave scattering models)
description: A set of benchmark problems for ultrasonic nondestructive evaluation modeled using full-wave scattering simulations to evaluate NDE methodologies.
evaluation_method: RMSE / reconstruction_error (and where applicable detection accuracy / IoU for imaging tasks)
notes: Specialized, domain-specific benchmark requiring physics-based simulation and significant compute; not an LLM benchmark; results depend heavily on simulation fidelity and solver choices; dataset/problem definitions may be small and tailored to full-wave models.
